normality_definition:
A screw bag contains exactly six hardware items: two split washers (flat rings with a visible gap/cut), two hexagonal nuts, one long hex-socket-head screw, and one short hex-socket-head screw.

COUNTS (exact):
- Washers: exactly 2. Small flat rings with a visible split/gap, silver colored.
- Nuts: exactly 2. Hexagonal silver metal pieces.
- Long screw: exactly 1. Hex socket head, long threaded shaft.
- Short screw: exactly 1. Hex socket head, shorter threaded shaft.

SIZE PROPORTIONS:
- The long screw is clearly longer than the short screw — the difference is visually obvious.
- The long screw is at least 3 times as long as the diameter of a washer.
- The short screw is at least as long as the height of a hexagonal nut.
- Both screws are of standard proportional length — neither abnormally tiny nor excessively long relative to the bag.
- Neither screw extends close to the full height of the bag.
